imageRegistry.description: Global container image registry, overrides `api.image.registry`, `web.image.registry` and the subchart's `image.registry`

imagePullSecrets.description: Global list of image pull secret names (e.g. `[befritco-docker-secret]`), merged with `api.image.pullSecrets` / `web.image.pullSecrets` and passed to the subchart

storageClass.description: Global storageClass for every PVC, overridden per volume by `api.persistence.<volume>.storageClass` / `rethinkdb.persistence.storageClass`

nameOverride.description: String to partially override expo-manager.fullname (keeps the release name)

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override expo-manager.fullname. Service names become `<fullnameOverride>-api` and `<fullnameOverride>-web`.

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every resource this chart creates (templated)

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every resource this chart creates (templated)

create.description: Create one ServiceAccount per component (api, web). Separate identities let a service mesh or NetworkPolicy tell the API (the only RethinkDB client) from the web nginx.

name.description: Name of the API's ServiceAccount. `<fullname>-api` when empty and `create` is true; `default` otherwise.

webName.description: Name of the web pod's ServiceAccount. `<fullname>-web` when empty and `create` is true; `default` otherwise.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token into the pods. Neither container talks to the Kubernetes API, so this stays off.

environment.description: `NODE_ENV` of the API. `production` hides stack traces and makes the API refuse to start on a weak/empty `JWT_SECRET` or `INITIAL_USER_PASSWORD`.

corsOrigins.description: `CORS_ORIGINS`: comma-separated allowlist of browser origins allowed to call the API (e.g. `https://expo.example.com`). Required -- the chart refuses to render with an empty value.

trustProxy.description: `TRUST_PROXY`: hop count of X-Forwarded-For-appending proxies in front of the API (see the comment above). Quoted string.

shutdownTimeoutMs.description: `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS`: bound on the API's graceful shutdown after SIGTERM before it force-exits. Must stay well below `api.terminationGracePeriodSeconds`.

logPretty.description: `LOG_PRETTY`: `true` for colourised pino-pretty output, `false` for JSON lines (what log collectors want)

apiDocsEnabled.description: `API_DOCS_ENABLED`: serve Swagger UI / the OpenAPI document at `/api-docs` to unauthenticated callers. Off by default in production; turn it on for development or a private instance.

photoMaxDecodedBytes.description: `PHOTO_MAX_DECODED_BYTES`: maximum decoded size of a photo upload; the JSON body-parser limit is derived from it

max.description: `LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX`: failed login attempts per window keyed on ip+username

windowMs.description: `LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`: window shared by both login rate limiters

ipMax.description: `LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_IP_MAX`: failed attempts per window keyed on ip only (keep high for venue Wi-Fi behind one NAT)

jwtSecret.description: `JWT_SECRET` (HS512 signing key). Ignored when `existingSecret` is set. When empty and `existingSecret` is unset, a random 48-character value is generated once and kept stable across upgrades.

initialUserPassword.description: `INITIAL_USER_PASSWORD`, the first admin user's password. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set. When empty and `existingSecret` is unset, a random 16-character value is generated once and kept stable across upgrades.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret carrying `jwt-secret`, `initial-user-password` and `email-sender-password` (plus `email-sender-oauth-client-secret` when `email.auth` is `oauth2-m365`), plus `rethinkdb-password` when the RethinkDB subchart is disabled. When set, the chart renders no Secret of its own. Point `rethinkdb.existingSecret` at the same Secret if it also carries `rethinkdb-password` for the bundled database.

auth.description: `EMAIL_SENDER_AUTH`: how the API logs in to the SMTP server: `password` (username + password, e.g. Mailu) or `oauth2-m365` (Microsoft 365 OAuth2 client credentials over SMTP XOAUTH2; server and port then default to smtp.office365.com:587). Port 587 always requires STARTTLS, 465 uses implicit TLS.

senderAddress.description: `EMAIL_SENDER_ADDRESS`: address checkout emails are sent from

senderPassword.description: `EMAIL_SENDER_PASSWORD`: SMTP password, stored in the chart Secret. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.

bcc.description: `EMAIL_BCC`: address every checkout email is blind-copied to

tenantId.description: `EMAIL_SENDER_OAUTH_TENANT_ID`: Entra tenant id (GUID) or domain, for `oauth2-m365`

clientId.description: `EMAIL_SENDER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`: application (client) id of the Entra app registration, for `oauth2-m365`

clientSecret.description: `EMAIL_SENDER_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET`: client secret of that app, stored in the chart Secret (`email-sender-oauth-client-secret`). Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.

fr.description: `CHECKOUT_TEXT_FR`: French text on the checkout email and PDF
fr.default: Si le stand est laissé sans déchets ni dégâts, la caution sera remboursée par virement bancaire endéans les 4 semaines.

nl.description: `CHECKOUT_TEXT_NL`: Dutch text on the checkout email and PDF
nl.default: Indien wij noch afval noch schade vaststellen, wordt de waarborg per overschrijving binnen de 4 weken teruggestort.

en.description: `CHECKOUT_TEXT_EN`: English text on the checkout email and PDF
en.default: If the stand is left without waste and damage, the guarantee will be returned to the bank account within 4 weeks.

entity.description: `CHECKOUT_ENTITY`: legal entity named in the checkout text

id.description: `EXPOSITION_ID`: id of the exposition the API seeds when no exposition with that id exists, and the fallback exposition of the PDF routes. Letters, digits, `_` and `-` only. Since api 3.0.0 the seed creates it from these values; the default matches the API's own (`exposition_id`).

name.description: `EXPOSITION_NAME`: name of the seeded exposition, applied only when it is created (rename it in the web app afterwards). Empty means the API default.

description.description: `EXPOSITION_DESCRIPTION`: description of the seeded exposition, applied only when it is created. Empty means the API default.

logo.description: `EXPOSITION_LOGO`: unused by the seed. Since api 3.0.0 logos are uploaded in the web app; anything but empty or an image data URI is ignored with a warning.

enabled.description: `APM_ENABLED`: enable Elastic APM instrumentation of the API

replicaCount.description: Number of API replicas. Must be `1`: there is no socket.io adapter, the photos/reports volumes are RWO and the migration ledger is not a lock. The chart refuses to render any other value unless `api.allowMultipleReplicas` is true.

allowMultipleReplicas.description: Acknowledge the risks above and allow `api.replicaCount` > 1 (you need RWX volumes, a socket.io adapter and a manually gated migration rollout)

tag.description: API image tag, defaults to the chart's `appVersion`

digest.description: API image digest (`sha256:...`), overrides `tag` when set

pullSecrets.description: API image pull secrets, merged with `global.imagePullSecrets`

containerPort.description: `API_PORT`, the port the API listens on and the container port

healthPath.description: Path of the API health endpoint used by every probe and by `helm test`. `/healthz` answers 200 once RethinkDB does, 503 before.

type.description: API Service type. The Service is named `<fullname>-api` and its port `http`.

port.description: API Service port. External HTTPRoutes/Ingresses target `<fullname>-api:<port>`.

type.description: Deployment strategy. Must stay `Recreate`: a rolling update would run two API versions at once, racing the boot migration.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL; must exceed `shutdownTimeoutMs` (10s) with headroom

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay seconds for the startupProbe
Initial delay seconds for the readinessProbe
Initial delay seconds for the livenessProbe

cpu.description: Requested CPU for the API container

memory.description: Requested memory for the API container

cpu.description: CPU limit for the API container (PDF rendering spawns Chromium)

memory.description: Memory limit for the API container

runAsNonRoot.description: Require the API pod to run as a non-root user

runAsUser.description: User ID of the API process (the image's `node` user)

runAsGroup.description: Group ID of the API process

fsGroup.description: Group that owns the mounted photos/reports volumes

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether the API process can gain more privileges than its parent

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Mount the container's root filesystem read-only (not supported by the Chromium-based PDF rendering; keep false)

sizeLimit.description: Size of the in-memory emptyDir mounted at `/dev/shm`. Required by Chromium (PDF rendering); the container default of 64MB crashes renders under load.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the API pod

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the API pod (a `checksum/config` annotation is always added)

nodeSelector.description: Node labels for API pod assignment

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the API pod

priorityClassName.description: Priority class of the API pod

initContainers.description: Extra init containers for the API pod (templated)

extraEnvVars.description: Extra environment variables for the API container, as a list of `{name, value}` / `{name, valueFrom}` entries (templated)

extraEnvVarsCM.description: Name of an existing ConfigMap whose keys are added to the API environment (`envFrom`)

extraEnvVarsSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret whose keys are added to the API environment (`envFrom`)

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes for the API pod (templated)

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the API container (templated)

resourcePolicy.description: Value of the `helm.sh/resource-policy` annotation on both PVCs. `keep` (the default) leaves them behind on `helm uninstall` so photos survive an accidental uninstall; set it to `""` to have them deleted with the release.

enabled.description: Create a PVC for `/expo/photos` (an emptyDir is used when false -- photos are lost on restart)

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the photos PVC. Empty uses `global.storageClass`, then the cluster default; `"-"` disables dynamic provisioning.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the photos PVC

labels.description: Extra labels for the photos PVC, e.g. a backup operator's repository label

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the photos PVC

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC to use instead of creating one (templated)

dataSource.description: Data source for the photos PVC, e.g. to restore from a VolumeSnapshot

enabled.description: Create a PVC for `/expo/reports` (an emptyDir is used when false)

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the reports PVC. Empty uses `global.storageClass`, then the cluster default; `"-"` disables dynamic provisioning.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the reports PVC

labels.description: Extra labels for the reports PVC

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the reports PVC

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC to use instead of creating one, e.g. the 1.x StatefulSet's `reports-<release>-expo-manager-api-0` (templated)

dataSource.description: Data source for the reports PVC

tag.description: Web image tag, defaults to the chart's `appVersion`

digest.description: Web image digest (`sha256:...`), overrides `tag` when set

pullSecrets.description: Web image pull secrets, merged with `global.imagePullSecrets`

containerPort.description: Port nginx listens on inside the container. The web image runs unprivileged from web 2.0.1 and listens on 8080.

healthPath.description: Path of the web health endpoint used by the probes and `helm test`. `/nginx-health` is a static 200 independent of the API.

apiUpstream.description: `API_UPSTREAM`, the `host:port` nginx proxies `/api/v1`, `/socket.io`, `/api-docs` and `/healthz` to. Defaults to `<fullname>-api:<api.service.port>`.

dnsResolver.description: `DNS_RESOLVER`, nginx's resolver. Auto-detected from the pod's /etc/resolv.conf when empty.

type.description: Web Service type. The Service is named `<fullname>-web` and its port `http`.

port.description: Web Service port. External HTTPRoutes/Ingresses target `<fullname>-web:<port>`.

type.description: Deployment strategy for the web tier

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL of the web pod

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds the preStop hook sleeps so in-flight requests drain while endpoints propagate. `0` disables the hook.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay seconds for the startupProbe
Initial delay seconds for the readinessProbe
Initial delay seconds for the livenessProbe

cpu.description: Requested CPU for the web container

memory.description: Requested memory for the web container

cpu.description: CPU limit for the web container

memory.description: Memory limit for the web container

runAsNonRoot.description: Require the web pod to run as a non-root user

runAsUser.description: User ID of nginx (the image's `nginx` user)

fsGroup.description: Group that owns the mounted emptyDirs

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether nginx can gain more privileges than its parent

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Mount the container's root filesystem read-only (the chart mounts emptyDirs at /etc/nginx/conf.d and /tmp)

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the web pod

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the web pod

nodeSelector.description: Node labels for web pod assignment

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the web pod

priorityClassName.description: Priority class of the web pod

initContainers.description: Extra init containers for the web pod (templated)

extraEnvVars.description: Extra environment variables for the web container (templated)

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes for the web pod (templated)

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the web container (templated)

enabled.description: Render a Gateway API HTTPRoute (`/api/`, `/socket.io` -> api; `/` -> web)

parentRefs.description: HTTPRoute `parentRefs`, copied verbatim (e.g. `[{group: gateway.networking.k8s.io, kind: Gateway, name: gw, namespace: istio-system}]`). Required when enabled.

labels.description: Extra labels for the HTTPRoute (e.g. an external-dns opt-in label)

enabled.description: Also render an HTTPRoute to the RethinkDB admin UI (`<release>-rethinkdb-admin:8080`). Requires `rethinkdb.httpAdmin.enabled`; the UI has no authentication of its own, so the parent Gateway must add some.

parentRefs.description: `parentRefs` of the admin HTTPRoute, defaults to `httpRoute.parentRefs`

labels.description: Extra labels for the admin HTTPRoute

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the admin HTTPRoute

enabled.description: Render an Ingress (`/api/`, `/socket.io` -> api; `/` -> web), all paths `pathType: Prefix`

annotations.description: Ingress annotations. Nothing is defaulted; add your controller's own (timeouts for socket.io long-polling, body size for photo uploads, cert-manager issuer...).

tls.description: Ingress TLS configuration, as a list of `{secretName, hosts}` entries

enabled.description: Create NetworkPolicies for the api and web pods

ingressFrom.description: List of NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach the web and api Services, e.g. the gateway namespace: `[{namespaceSelector: {matchLabels: {kubernetes.io/metadata.name: istio-system}}}]`

extraIngress.description: Extra ingress rules for the api policy, verbatim

extraEgress.description: Extra egress rules for the api policy, verbatim (SMTP, APM, an external RethinkDB...)

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget per component. With single replicas this only turns voluntary evictions into a blocked drain, so it defaults off.

minAvailable.description: `minAvailable` of both PodDisruptionBudgets (takes precedence over `maxUnavailable` when set)

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled single-node RethinkDB StatefulSet. When false, `rethinkdb.externalHost` is required.

externalHost.description: Hostname of an external RethinkDB (driver port 28015) used when `rethinkdb.enabled` is false. The password is read from `rethinkdb.existingSecret` if set, else from this chart's Secret (`rethinkdb-password` key).

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret carrying the RethinkDB admin password under `rethinkdb-password`. Read by the subchart and by the API; typically the same Secret as `existingSecret`.

rethinkdbPassword.description: RethinkDB admin password, ignored when `rethinkdb.existingSecret` is set. Empty means the subchart generates one (or, with `rethinkdb.enabled=false`, an empty password for the external database).

enabled.description: Enable the RethinkDB admin UI and its `<release>-rethinkdb-admin` Service. Off by default -- the UI has no authentication; only expose it behind a gateway that adds some.

size.description: Size of the RethinkDB data PVC

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the data PVC, empty uses `global.storageClass` then the cluster default

labels.description: Extra labels for the data PVC, e.g. a backup operator's repository label

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the data PVC

registry.description: Image registry for the `helm test` pod

repository.description: Image repository for the `helm test` pod (needs `curl`)

tag.description: Image tag for the `helm test` pod

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the `helm test` pod
